required_for_final_qualification: primary native-provenance.json with validated status PASS
one validated repeat-native-provenance.json per repeat stream
exact-byte determinism PASS across primary and repeats
repeat_binding_rule: Every repeat provenance must resolve to the same candidate_git_sha, candidate source SHA-256, candidate binary SHA-256, and fixture source SHA-256 as the primary native run. Its stream SHA-256 must match its own repeat stream.
consumer_outputs: determinism.json when repeated streams are supplied
triage.json when conformance is not PASS

authority_rules.native_provenance: S3-Benchmarks validate_s3ir2_v2_native_provenance.py recomputes candidate-source, candidate-binary, fixture, and stream hashes
authority_rules.repeat_run_binding: S3-Benchmarks ingest_s3ir2_v2_evidence_set.py requires every repeated run to be proven against the same candidate binary/source/fixture identity

promotion_rule: A completeness bit alone never promotes a lane. Final laboratory qualification requires structural PASS, primary and repeat native provenance PASS bound to the same candidate, S3 strict semantic conformance PASS, and deterministic repeated stream bytes. S3-Benchmarks still has no authority to mutate or promote the S3 compiler.
mutation_rule: The consumer is read-only with respect to the S3 checkout and candidate artifacts.
